author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
translation: V. Yuktu is here used in the sense of one who can restrain his mind from being distracted. The idea in the first line must be taken as the second step and so the words in this line should be construed with the genitive case in the third line. Also supply the words Na che Abuddheh before Sânti. Accordingly the translation is given.
